evidence.notes: v2 recorded output_tokens often at/near 2048-boundary effects (empty content or truncated JSON) despite max_tokens=2048 request; several repairs still empty/truncated.

recommendation.rationale: Several v2 responses were empty or truncated near the 2048 output-token boundary. Raising planner/planner_repair max_tokens to 4096 may reduce empty/truncated finals and can reduce the need for a second repair call; total LLM calls/task remain <=8 with at most one planner repair. Binder/Reason/Final keep prior max_tokens.
recommendation.cost_trade_off: Higher per-call output ceiling on planner stages only. May increase tokens when models emit longer valid plans, but may decrease total calls by avoiding repair. Worst-case calls/task unchanged (planner <=2 including one repair; total LLM <=8).
